# IPlugin

Namespace `AutoSettings.Sdk` · interface

```csharp
public interface IPlugin
```

The entry point of a .NET plugin. AutoSettings creates one instance of the class that implements it (the class needs a public parameterless constructor) and calls [`IPlugin.Configure`](IPlugin.md#configure) once when the plugin starts.

**Example**

```csharp
public sealed class UsbPlugin : IPlugin
{
    public void Configure(IPluginBuilder builder) =>
        builder.AddAction(new EjectAction()).AddTrigger(new DriveWatcher());
}
```

## Methods

### Configure

```csharp
void Configure(IPluginBuilder builder)
```

Registers the plugin's actions, conditions and triggers.

|---|---|
